title: Multi-predicate relationship
description: Code-style rule — relationships joining on three or more field predicates. Very wide join keys are hard to reason about and often signal a missing key field.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Multi-field join keys are brittle and hint at a missing surrogate key.
rule.remediation: Introduce a single composite / surrogate key field where practical.
